interpreted_intent: Continue the established Republic of Korea special-warfare promotional campaign with the same adult woman, changing the prior full-body running image into a forceful upper-body portrait in which she aims her carbine directly along the camera axis.
subject: The same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait, equipped as a modern Republic of Korea special-warfare operator.
setting: A rain-wet concrete military obstacle-course environment softened behind the operator.
event: The operator shoulders and steadily aims a compact carbine straight toward the camera in a disciplined pre-shot training moment.
visual_priorities: Upper-body-only framing with the face still recognizable above the optic
Convincing barrel foreshortening, two-hand weapon control, and camera-axis aim
Premium Republic of Korea national-defense campaign atmosphere
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces special-warfare promotional poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait. Preserve her long oval face, eye aperture and spacing, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair. Show only her upper body, framed from mid-torso upward. She shoulders a compact carbine and aims it straight toward the camera, both gloved hands controlling the weapon with a firm cheek weld; the muzzle and front sight dominate the immediate foreground while her focused face remains clearly visible above the optic. The camera is aligned with the bore axis just below her eye line. Her trigger finger lies indexed straight along the receiver in a disciplined ready-to-aim moment. Matte helmet, communications headset, rain-darkened combat uniform, plate carrier, pouches, and Republic of Korea flag patch remain coherent. A rain-wet concrete training compound falls softly out of focus behind her. Strong barrel foreshortening, suspended rain droplets, cool storm haze, and warm rim light create premium national-defense campaign key art: tense, controlled, capable, and decisive.
